name: grok-build-gui
description: Codex-style desktop client for the Grok Build harness.
author: Grok Build GUI contributors

scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run icon && electron-builder --publish never -c.mac.identity=null -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=false
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && npm run icon && electron-builder --dir --publish never -c.mac.identity=null -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=false
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && npm run icon && electron-builder --mac --publish never -c.mac.identity=null -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=false
scripts.package:mac:release: npm run build && npm run icon && electron-builder --mac --publish never -c.forceCodeSigning=true -c.mac.notarize=true
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && npm run icon && electron-builder --linux --publish never
